WARNING: This Game is in ALPHA - Expect Bugs
New Content Weekly!

You no-clipped out of reality, will you survive? 

Features:
- Player Leveling, Skill Tree's and Stats ⭐
- Faction System 🏠
- Field Journal 📖
- Create-A-Wanderer 🎨
- Base Building 🔨 
- Emotes 🕺
- Weapons to Fight Back⚔️
- And more!

This is an Open World RPG non linear take on the Backrooms!

30+ Levels Currently Added

New Levels Weekly!

PC Controls: 
Q = Shift Lock
Shift = Sprint

Mobile & Console Controls display in game
